meta.units: t s; p m; crush_mm mm; force_N N; load_factor g; tilt deg
meta.frame: world Z up (touchdown ground plane z=0); body x aft (down in stance), y right, z cruise-up (world +X in stance). R0 maps the upright stance to body->world.
meta.p: CG position in world axes [x, y, z]
meta.tilt_deg: angle of body +x from world down; 0 = upright stance (as tilt_end)
meta.pads: order = landing_a feet: (sy,sz) = (+1,+1), (+1,-1), (-1,+1), (-1,-1); y = sy*y_foot (+y right wing fin), z_body = sz*z_foot
meta.crush_mm: penetration depth d of the pad (elastic + plastic); capped only by the stop spring beyond s_max
meta.load_factor_g: sum of pad normal forces / (m g): same definition as n_peak (rotor lift excluded)
meta.rotor_lift_frac: lam ramp: 0.667 until 0.3 s, to 0 at 0.6 s (C1 convention)
meta.t098_basis: D-243 chosen point; rib 25x23; mass 1.881 kg; T097 part table
